name: Jarvis-2.0 optional Gods Eye View
origin_claim: README mentions 20 layers and map sources; table has 23 rows

layers.name: 🗺️ Map Stack
layers.source_description: Esri satellite imagery, Google Photorealistic 3D, OSM, plus additional ion-hosted stacks
layers.credential_requirements: 🟢 Esri satellite + OSM · 🟡 ion-hosted Google 3D + world terrain · 🔴 direct Google + place search

layers.name: ✈️ Live Flights
layers.source_description: 11,000+ live aircraft + route history

layers.name: 🎖️ Military Flights
layers.source_description: ADS-B military traffic in amber, emergency broadcasts in red

layers.name: 📡 GNSS Integrity
layers.source_description: Regional navigation accuracy scores; anomalies do not confirm interference

layers.name: 🔥 Fire Perimeters
layers.source_description: Incident boundaries and reported containment

layers.name: 🚢 Live Vessels
layers.source_description: Thousands of ships worldwide

layers.name: 🛰️ Satellites
layers.source_description: 838-object catalog, color-coded by class with a live legend — the **DENSE** chip drops in the whole Starlink shell

layers.name: 🌍 Earthquakes
layers.source_description: Global seismic activity, last 24h

layers.name: ◍ Air quality
layers.source_description: Live AQHI on the published 1–10+ health-risk scale, with a Weather-panel card showing the band legend and the highest readings in view. **Canada only** — ECCC is the first registered provider

layers.name: 🚗 Traffic
layers.source_description: Simulated vehicles on OSM roads. With TomTom, live flow speeds drive the simulation and congestion colors below ~8 km; individual vehicle positions are not live observations

layers.name: 📹 CCTV Mesh
layers.source_description: ~4,000 public cameras (shared cap) projected _into_ the 3D space — Austin · Texas (TxDOT) · California (Caltrans) · London (TfL) · Ontario (511) · Finland (Fintraffic) · British Columbia (DriveBC) · Estonia (Tallinn, Tarktee) · Delaware (DelDOT live video) · New South Wales (Live Traffic NSW) · Calgary · Norway (Statens vegvesen) · Toronto · King County (WA) · Washington (WSDOT) · Catalonia (Servei Català de Trànsit), plus opt-in New York City (NYC DOT TMC, needs your own NYC DOT agreement) and opt-in Lithuania (Via Lietuva / Eismoinfo, photo licence unconfirmed). Positions are published; poses are estimated priors **you calibrate by dragging a gizmo on the camera itself**

layers.name: 📷 Mapped ALPR Cameras
layers.source_description: License-plate-reader camera locations tagged by OpenStreetMap contributors, loaded one city-sized view at a time, with **SHOW NEAREST**. Locations and tags only: no plate data, no video

layers.name: 📷 Street Level
layers.source_description: Street-level photos behind one panel, one chip per provider: coverage on the streets, image cones, an embedded viewer and **FOLLOW**. Mapillary, Google Street View, KartaView and Panoramax
layers.credential_requirements: 🟢 KartaView, Panoramax · 🟡 Mapillary token · 🔴 Google Maps key

layers.name: 📻 Radio
layers.source_description: Geolocated world radio with an **analog tuner** — drag the needle across up to 750 stations and the globe flies to each broadcaster

layers.name: 🚌 Transit
layers.source_description: Live buses, trams, metros, trains and ferries with delayed playback between reports, selected-vehicle trails, and mode-coloured DETECT labels — Boston, Austin, Minneapolis, Helsinki, the Netherlands, Norway, South East Queensland, and nine in Ontario: Toronto (surface vehicles; the subway publishes no positions), Mississauga, Hamilton, Durham Region, York Region, Guelph, Burlington, Barrie and Kingston

layers.name: 🚲 Bikeshare
layers.source_description: Live station availability

layers.name: 🧭 Directions
layers.source_description: Click A and B on the globe for a street-following drive, walk or cycle route draped on the terrain with turn-by-turn steps — then FLY the camera along it. No key, no geocoder, no mic

layers.name: 🔥 Active Fires
layers.source_description: Live NASA FIRMS detections, trailing 24h

layers.name: 🚀 Space Missions
layers.source_description: Rolling 30-day launches with payload, stage, and recovery detail

layers.name: 🎖️ Mapped Installations
layers.source_description: Viewport-bounded military-site context from community mapping — incomplete by nature, and labeled that way

layers.name: 🌬️ Wind
layers.source_description: Animated 10 m forecast wind with an optional speed, temperature or pressure color field and a reading at map center

layers.name: 🌦️ Observed Weather
layers.source_description: Rain radar (contiguous US), Satellite clouds (GOES regional or global infrared, Clouds only or Full image) and Lightning density (Americas and Pacific) on one history timeline

layers.name: 🌀 Cyclones
layers.source_description: Advisory positions, forecast tracks and uncertainty cones for the Atlantic and eastern/central North Pacific
